tool_analysis: Step Analysis: The recorded steps navigate to a WordPress post page and submit the comment form. The interaction history shows corrected stable element indices and element hashes for the textarea, name, email, url, cookie consent checkbox, and submit button. Task Definition: Create a parameterized tool to post a comment on the specific post (p=8) using the stable selectors. Action Plan: 1) Navigate to the post URL. 2) Wait for page load. 3) Fill textarea#comment with {comment}. 4) Fill input#author with {author}. 5) Fill input#email with {email}. 6) Fill input#url with {url} (optional). 7) Click the cookies consent checkbox (element hash 42c420143d). 8) Click the submit button (element hash 777443c52e). 9) Wait and extract page content to confirm the posted comment. Variable Identification: comment, author, email, url, save_cookies. Step Optimization: Combined minimal waits to avoid timing failures; used CSS selectors matching WordPress default (form#commentform textarea#comment, input#author, input#email, input#url, input#wp-comment-cookies-consent) and recorded elementHash as deterministic fallback. Reduced earlier erroneous index usage by relying on elementHash and stable IDs. The final extraction step confirms success. Note: Authentication not required. The tool requires the 'url' parameter optional to allow empty string when omitted. Error handling: Added brief waits before and after submission to mitigate timing issues that caused previous attempt timeouts.
name: tool_post_comment.v5
description: Submit a comment on a WordPress post at http://localhost:8000/?p=8 using deterministic selectors recorded during interaction. The site is pre-authenticated. The tool fills comment textarea, name, email, optional URL, toggles cookie consent, and submits the comment. Uses stable element hashes and improved selectors to avoid timing and ambiguity issues.

steps.description: Navigate to the target post page where the comment form resides.
Wait briefly for the page to finish loading and for dynamic comment form elements to be available.
Fill the comment textarea with the provided comment text.
Fill the Name field with the provided display name.
Fill the Email field with the provided email address.
Fill the optional Website field with the provided URL (leave empty string to skip).
Toggle 'Save my name, email, and website in this browser' if requested by the caller (tool passes click regardless; caller sets save_cookies to control).
Click the 'Post Comment' submit button to submit the comment form.
Wait for the server to process the submission and update the page (redirect to #comment-<id> or append the new comment).
Extract the newly added comment content and its anchor (e.g., '#comment-21') to confirm success.
steps.goal: Confirm that the new comment appears in the comments list and capture the latest comment content and URL hash.

input_schema.name: comment
input_schema.description: Comment text to post in the textarea (HTML will be escaped by the site).

input_schema.name: author
input_schema.description: Display name to post with the comment (matches the 'Name' field).

input_schema.name: email
input_schema.description: Email address to post with the comment (must be valid format).

input_schema.name: url
input_schema.description: Optional website URL to include with the comment (include scheme 'https://' if present).

input_schema.name: save_cookies
input_schema.description: If true, toggle the 'Save my name, email, and website in this browser' checkbox (default: false).
